coordinates.locator: INR laboratory page (hall 550 m from the start of the horizontal tunnel) and OpenStreetMap node 4244310615 (Main adit entrance)
coordinates.note: Campus-grade: the point is the OpenStreetMap Main adit entrance of the Baksan Neutrino Observatory. The INR page puts the BUST hall 550 m inside the horizontal tunnel but gives no bearing, so the hall lies within about 550 m (precision stated 700 m) of this point. Not a surveyed hall position (rank-11 OpenStreetMap source, A17).
coordinates.quote: Телескоп расположен в горной выработке объемом 12000 куб. метров на расстоянии 550м от начала горизонтального тоннеля.

depth_mwe.quote: at the effective depth of 8.5 × 104 g · cm−2 (850 m of w.e.)

summary.plain: The excavated hall in Mount Andyrchi, in the Northern Caucasus, that holds the Baksan scintillation telescope, 550 metres inside the tunnel under about 850 metres of water-equivalent rock.
summary.technical: Hall (12,000 m^3 excavation) 550 m from the start of the horizontal tunnel, effective overburden 850 m w.e. (8.5e4 g/cm^2); marked with the main adit entrance point, approximate.
